name: Cello
summary:
A cello, in mixed reality.

Draw the bow across the strings and pick out any tune by ear.

Never played before? Turn pitch assist on and keep every note in tune.

Play with friends online, whichever Fncore instrument they have: Violinest, Trombonest, Trumpeteer or Cello.

The music stand shows you how to play 49 pieces, like the Prelude from Bach's first cello suite, marking every note on the strings as you go.
